instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use default tailwind slate/gray; stick to pure black, white, and red/blue accents.
For headings, install and apply 'Bebas Neue'. Body text should use 'IBM Plex Sans'.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Do not use card components everywhere. Rely on raw divs with borders (border-white/10) to create a 'Control Room' grid layout.
Implement Shadcn UI for forms, selects, and dialogs, but override their default styles to match the dark tactical theme (remove border-radius, use sharp edges).
Library cards should be dense and informative, using hover states to reveal depth.
Use Framer Motion for subtle page load staggers and route transitions.
The Progress page should emphasize data visualization. Use Recharts with the defined brand colors (Red, Blue, White).
Do not use generic placeholder text; populate dummy data realistically suited for a Jiu-Jitsu training app.
